headline: Weathered Expanse Ignites as Central Lines Reel Under Fresh Assaults
war_summary: The brief deadlock reported earlier in Weathered Expanse has shattered violently, with the frozen sector erupting into ten base turnovers in the past two hours amid over three thousand fresh casualties as Frostmarch, Crow's Nest, and Shattered Advance traded hands. Turmoil also persists along Stlican Shelf, where five recent base transitions have left the snowy corridor divided and one position reduced to neutral ruins. To the west, the fierce contest across Fisherman's Row has cooled considerably following earlier upheaval, settling into firm Colonial possession of all nine bases as frontline firing slackened. However, coastal skirmishing has rippled into Farranac Coast, logging two swift changes over The Bone Haft. Meanwhile, territorial exchanges in Mooring County have paused over the last two hours, though intense fighting continues to claim more than thirteen hundred casualties around the lone Colonial redoubt. Heavy attrition without immediate line shifts also marks Callahan's Passage and Stonecradle, where infantry engagements remain severe across contested ground.
